title: The Academic record
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：academic　|　正文 330 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 academic 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the counsellor wrote of ① an academic record in the journal, and everybody in the garden said at once that it was ② more academic than the one named there the year before. Three evenings on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the counsellor, who never explained anything, had done it on the same day and gone home; it was the academic ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most academic record anybody in the garden had ever seen, or so the journal for June 1971 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too academic to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the listener who had come to help; the academic ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an academic question of method, and said that no listener in his right mind would call it ⑥ as academic as the question of method they had once had in the old garden. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was academic or not, and he said so.

By 1984 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the journal. What the line asked for was ⑦ something academic, and nothing besides. The listener from the next garden called the whole plan ⑧ quite academic; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the journal kept the names of the academic ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1987, before dawn, she wrote of another academic record in the same journal, and the work, which took two evenings, seemed  more academic than anybody had expected.  The most academic question of method in the whole garden, she said in 1989, was the one she could never quite name; the academic ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 学业（前置定语 an academic record：1977 年谈心人在心记里记下的那件学业的成绩单）
B. adj. 学业／学术（比较级 more academic than：文中两处，一处比成绩单，一处比预想）
C. adj. 学业／学术（最高级 the most academic：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 学业（表语 too academic to do：母亲觉得它太学业，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 学术（前置定语 an academic question of method：叔叔把整件事称作一桩学术的争论）
F. adj. 学术（同级比较 as academic as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩方法上的争论相比）
G. adj. 学术（后置定语 something academic：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 学术（受程度副词修饰 quite academic：那位倾听者的评价）

answers.why: academic 意为“学业”，1977 年谈心人在心记里记下的是“一件学业的成绩单”，此处作前置定语 an academic record。
academic 意为“学业”，此处用比较级 more academic than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
academic 意为“学业”，心记上 六月 那行字说它是小园里最学业的一件，故用最高级 the most academic record。
academic 意为“学业”，母亲认为这件东西“太学业了，谁也用不上”，too academic to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
academic 意为“学术”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩学术的争论”，此处作前置定语 an academic question of method。
academic 意为“学术”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩方法上的争论一样学术”，同级比较用 as academic as。
academic 意为“学术”，心记上那半行字要的是“学术的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something academic。
academic 意为“学术”，邻小园来的那位倾听者认为这套计划“相当学术”，quite 修饰原级 academic。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1977 年，谈心人在心记里记下了一件学业的成绩单。（an academic record）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更学业。（more academic than …）
母亲觉得它太学业，谁也用不上。（too academic to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩学术的争论。（an academic question of method）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩方法上的争论一样学术。（as academic as …）
到了 1984 年，心记上只剩半行字：要的是一件学术的东西。（something academic）
answers: In 1977 the counsellor wrote of an academic record in the journal.
Everybody said it was more academic than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too academic to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an academic question of method.
He said nobody would call it as academic as the question of method they had once had.
By 1984 the journal asked for nothing but something academic.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 academic 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1977 the counsellor wrote of an academic record in the journal, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most academic record in the garden, or so the journal says.
My mother thought it too academic to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an academic question of method, and nobody argued with him.
The listener from the next garden called the plan quite academic, and everybody laughed.
The academic ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
